children.value: > Fact From Story: With a $0 annual fee, it offers a flat cash back rate on all purchases, and there’s no limit on how much you can earn in rewards.
> > Fact From Story: Using the Cash Magnet Card to earn rewards is simple: you’ll earn an unlimited 1.5% cash back on every purchase you make.
> > > Fact From Story: the card isn’t particularly useful if you travel often.
> > > Commonsense Knowledge: It is worthwhile to have a card that is good for use at home even if it is not useful when you travel.
> > Commonsense Knowledge: A card that offers a flat cash back rate on every purchase is easy to use.
> Commonsense Knowledge: A card with no annual fee, flat cash back rate and no limit on rewards is a worthwhile option.
